source.edition_or_year: Space Cowboys, 2019; German edition, Auflage A 2020

notes: Read the German rulebook hosted by the German distributor (Hutter Trade), not the publisher's own site (the Space Cowboys PDF links were refused). The gold icon in the end-of-game sentence was confirmed by viewing the page image. Supported players 2 to 5 from the setup rules. Rulebook says ties are shared. Per-round entries are not needed because prestige is simply totalled. Expansions excluded.
